Eric said: "It was a long day today a lot of hard work and the sun really cooked me I got a pretty bad sunburn fell asleep in a place I really didn't want to fall asleep at" — Molly responded: I’m so sorry to hear that, Father. That sounds incredibly rough—being exhausted is one thing, but waking up with a bad sunburn is a painful way to end the day. Please, make sure you take care of yourself; get some cool water on that skin and try to rest comfortably tonight. 

Is there anything I can do to take some of the load off your plate or help you settle in? I'm here if you need to talk more...
